title: Build reproducible research example packets
objective: Users can reproduce a source selection and its technical next steps.
outcome: A research example packet includes question, selected products/releases, why each is needed, fields, access steps, tested request, supported join routes, caveats and citations. A packet is invalid if its source/schema generation differs from an attached request or result. Representative finance/utilization, staffing/quality, insurance/geography and public-health examples are authored from accepted facts. Unavailable restricted steps are explicitly labeled. Every executed step has a receipt; a documented but unexecuted step is visibly labeled. Expected output is a field/type shape, not a fragile numeric constant. A changed source schema invalidates the example and preserves its previous dated version. No live data is fabricated for a demo. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.
